html:
On 17 January 1893 a group of American and European businessmen in Honolulu overthrew Queen Liliʻuokalani, backed by US Marines landed from a warship. It ended the Kingdom of Hawaii.

The queen had tried to bring in a new constitution restoring royal power and the votes of Native Hawaiians, which the sugar interests had cut back in 1887. She yielded to avoid bloodshed.

President Cleveland called the overthrow wrong, but the plotters set up a republic, and the United States annexed Hawaii in 1898. In 1993 Congress formally apologised. The overthrow is still the core grievance of the Hawaiian sovereignty movement, decades after statehood.
